name: Queensland macadamias
about: Macadamia nuts are native to Queensland, and this is where they are grown and processed. They are sold roasted or coated in chocolate.
tip: Choose a small pack first to check the flavour, since the chocolate-coated and roasted types taste quite different.

name: Queensland Bundaberg rum
about: Bundaberg rum is made in Queensland, and the state has a long distilling tradition. It is a popular local spirit to take home.
tip: The basic aged version is the budget choice and works well as a gift.
